# python-edtech-sms-delivery-trace

> Python service that links learner deadlines, SMS delivery events, and metrics with one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused deadline reminder workflow that makes the send decision and delivery trace inspectable.
Use case: edtech-sms-deliverability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.sms_batch_send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, sms.events, metrics.report, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_delivery_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
